# Aim 1 Power

```{r}
omnibus_power_sweep <- function(n = 175, p = 2, alpha = 0.025,
                        r_range = seq(0.05, 0.65, by = 0.05)){
  
  results <- data.frame()
  
  for(r2 in r2_range){
    
    pwr <- mlrF.overall(N = n, p = p, Rsq = r2, alpha = alpha)
    results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
        r2 = r2,
        pwr = pwr
    ))
  }
  return(results)
}

omnibus_power_sweep()
```

```{r}
individ_power_sweep <- function(n = 175, alpha = 0.025,
                        r_range = seq(0.25, 0.75, by = 0.1)){
  
  results <- data.frame()
  
  for(r in r_range){
    
    pwr <- corr.1samp(N = n, rhoA = r, alpha = alpha)
    results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
        r = r,
        pwr = pwr
    ))
  }
  return(results)
}

individ_power_sweep()
```

```{r}
n_power_sweep <- function(n = 175, alpha = 0.025,
                        r_range = seq(0.25, 0.75, by = 0.1),
                        trt_prop = c(0.25, 0.4, 0.5, 0.6, 0.75)){
  
  results <- data.frame()
  
  for (prop in trt_prop){
    n_amci = round(n * prop, 0)
    n_cont = 175 - n_amci
    for(r in r_range){
      
      pwr <- corr.2samp(n1 = n_amci, rho1 = r, rho2 = 0.2, alpha = alpha)
      results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
          n_amci = n_amci,
          n_cont = n_cont,
          r = r,
          pwr = pwr
      ))
    }
  }
    return(results)
}

n_power_sweep()
```

```{r}
enrollment_sensitivity <- function(
    n_range = seq(100, 225, by = 25),
    p = 2,
    alpha = 0.025,
    r_range = seq(0.25, 0.75, by = 0.1)
) {
  results <- data.frame()
  
  for (n in n_range) {
    for (r in r_range) {
      
      pwr_omni  <- mlrF.overall(N = n, p = p, Rsq = r^2, alpha = alpha)
      pwr_indiv <- corr.1samp(N = n, rhoA = r, alpha = alpha)
      
      results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
        n_total    = n,
        r          = r,
        pwr_omni   = pwr_omni,
        pwr_indiv  = pwr_indiv
      ))
    }
  }
  return(results)
}

enroll <- enrollment_sensitivity()

enroll_long <- pivot_longer(enroll,
  cols      = c(pwr_omni, pwr_indiv),
  names_to  = "test",
  values_to = "power"
)
enroll_long$test <- ifelse(enroll_long$test == "pwr_omni",
                           "Omnibus", "Individual")

ggplot(enroll_long, aes(x = n_total, y = power,
                         color = factor(r), group = factor(r))) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.80, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray40") +
  facet_wrap(~ test) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(name = "r") +
  labs(
    title = "Enrollment sensitivity",
    x = "Total N",
    y = "Power"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
